scientific_claim: The invalid R1 target-schedule failure is attributable to an over-strict cross-file support rule rather than absence of useful real-byte motifs. Under the predeclared tier ladder, Tier 1 is the strictest schedule yielding at least two eligible motifs in both immutable held-out files: it requires calibration occurrence >=6, diagnostic/validation/audit occurrence >=3 each, and calibration motif-over-baseline accuracy gain >=0.20.
preservation: No R1 partial maintenance cycle is interpreted as scientific evidence. R2 may change only target eligibility to the mechanically selected Tier 1; the monitor, candidate budgets/order, validation retain rule, audit, corpus, model, and scientific thresholds remain otherwise unchanged.
